On-time service you can always trust

items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: That oversized couch isn’t going to move itself — and it definitely shouldn’t take your back with it. At
Live Junk Free
, we’ve built our reputation on one promise: we make couch removal completely effortless for homeowners.

Whether your sofa is wedged in a third-floor apartment, crammed in a narrow basement stairwell, or simply too heavy to tackle on your own, our crew arrives fully equipped to handle it all. We disassemble pieces when needed, protect your floors and door frames throughout, and haul everything away without leaving a trace behind.

Every job starts with a free, no-obligation quote — you’ll know exactly what you’re paying before we lift a finger. Once you give the go-ahead, we take care of disassembly (if required), careful extraction, and responsible disposal through local recycling centers or donation organizations. We finish by tidying the area so your space feels open and fresh the moment we leave.

Serving communities throughout the Canada, we combine speed, affordability, and environmental responsibility into every single job. Stop letting that couch take up space in your home and your head. Let us clear it out today.

blocks.text: The Fastest Way to Clear That Couch Out of Your Life

c: Dragging a heavy sofa across hardwood floors, wrestling it around tight corners, or trying to squeeze a pull-out couch down a staircase — this is exactly how injuries and damaged walls happen. Don’t risk it. Our team is trained specifically for challenging
furniture removals
and arrives with the right equipment every single time.

We understand life doesn’t always give you a week’s notice. That’s why we offer same-day and next-day removal for most locations across the GTA. Whether you’re staging your home for sale, making room for a new piece, or just done looking at that beat-up sofa, we can be there fast.
Our team is fully insured, professionally uniformed, and courteous — your home will be treated with the same care we’d give our own. Every job includes:

items: Disassembly of oversized or mechanical couches when required
Careful extraction using floor and wall protection
Responsible disposal through recycling centers or donation partners
Post-removal tidy-up so your space is clean and ready to use

blocks.text: Benefits of Choosing Live Junk Free for Couch Removal

items.title: We Show Up When We Say We Will — Every Single Time
text: Unreliable crews who cancel last minute or show up hours late are the number one complaint homeowners have about

c: junk removal companies

text: . At Live Junk Free, punctuality isn’t a perk — it’s a standard. When we give you a booking window, our crew arrives within it, ready to work. No vague “we’ll be there sometime in the afternoon.” We respect your time because it’s valuable.

items.title: The Price You're Quoted Is the Price You Pay — Period
text: Hidden fees at the end of a job are a frustrating industry norm we’ve chosen to reject entirely. Before we move a single item, you’ll have a firm, written quote covering labor, hauling, disassembly if needed, and full disposal. When we wrap up the job, that same number appears on your invoice. No surprises, no pressure to add on, no awkward conversations at the door.

items.title: We Treat Your Home Like It's Our Own
text: Our crew arrives in uniform, removes shoes or wears boot covers inside your home, and uses protective padding on walls, floors, and door frames before anything is moved. We maneuver carefully through every space — no rushing, no scraping, no shortcuts. When we leave, the only difference you’ll notice is the open space where your old couch used to be.

items.title: We Take Eco-Friendly Disposal Seriously — Not Just Symbolically
text: A lot of companies claim to be eco-friendly while hauling everything straight to the nearest landfill. We don’t. Every item we collect is assessed for donation potential, material recyclability, and reuse opportunities before disposal is even considered. Over 90% of what we remove is diverted from landfill through active recycling partnerships and furniture donation programs with local shelters and community organizations.

items.title: Fully Licensed, Fully Insured — You're Protected Throughout
text: When you let a crew into your home, you deserve to know they’re covered. Live Junk Free is fully licensed to operate and carries comprehensive liability insurance on every job. If anything unexpected happens — however unlikely — you’re protected. We never cut corners on compliance, because your peace of mind starts before we even arrive at the door.

items.title: Real People Answer Your Call — Not a Bot, Not a Voicemail
text: From your first call to job completion, you’ll deal with real, knowledgeable people who can actually answer your questions, give you an accurate quote, and get you booked immediately. No automated phone trees, no 48-hour email turnarounds, no being bounced between departments. We pick up within 60 seconds and we handle everything from there — because that’s what good service looks like.

c: One couch, one pickup, all cleanup included. Perfect for a single sofa, loveseat, or recliner.

blocks.text: We Remove ALL Types of Couches & Sofas!

c: Whether it weighs 80 pounds or 400, whether it disassembles or doesn’t, whether it’s from a basement or a penthouse — if it’s a couch, we remove it.

blocks.text: From Call to Clear — Here's What Happens

items.title: Text Us a Photo of Your Couch
text: Snap a quick photo and text it to +1 647 922 5865. Show us the couch and the space it's in — that's all we need to give you an accurate quote on the spot.

items.title: Receive a Clear, All-In Quote
text: No "we'll let you know when we get there." You'll have a firm price in writing before we book anything. Labor, hauling, and disposal — all included. Nothing added at the door.

items.title: Choose a Time That Works for You
text: Pick same-day, next morning, or any time that suits your schedule — including weekends. We work around your life, not the other way around.

items.title: We Arrive, We Remove, We Clean Up
text: Our crew shows up on time, handles every inch of the job — disassembly if needed, careful extraction, full cleanup — and hauls your couch away for responsible disposal. Most jobs are wrapped up in under an hour.

c: See how we transform cluttered, overcrowded spaces into clean, functional areas—done efficiently, with care, and zero hassle.

items.q: Do you only remove pull-out couches?
a: We take all furniture, sectionals, recliners, mattresses, and even whole room clearouts.

items.q: Can you remove them from the apartments?
a: Yes! We service high-rises, condos, and walk-ups; no job is too tricky.

items.q: What if my couch won’t fit through the door?
a: We expertly disassemble furniture to remove it safely without damage.

items.q: Do you take other items too?
a: Yes! Ask about bundle deals for TVs, tables, and other junk.
Absolutely. We’re fully licensed and insured for your protection.
